known_visual_features: Rectangular development board with two long female header strips along opposite edges
USB-B connector and 2.1x5.5 mm barrel jack on one short edge
Digital header silkscreen labels 0-13 next to the pins; PWM-capable pins carry a '~' marker (pin 9 is PWM-capable)
Power header with labels such as 5V, 3.3V, GND, VIN

terminals.name: GND
terminals.description: Ground. The board exposes several GND header pins (JANALOG pins 6 and 7, JDIGITAL pin 15); all are the board ground net.

internal_nets.name: GND
internal_nets.note: Every GND header pin is modelled as the single terminal 'GND'.

parts.electrical_limits_note: No current or voltage limits are stored for this MVP, so Wirewise does not check pin current. Anything not stored here is reported as NOT CHECKED.

sources.title: Arduino UNO R3 datasheet (A000066), section 5 Connector Pinouts (JANALOG / JDIGITAL tables)

parts.verification_note: Pin names and functions were copied from the official datasheet connector tables. Silkscreen hints are visual cues only and are never used as electrical facts. Clone boards may differ; the user must confirm their board matches the UNO R3 header layout.

known_visual_features: Small cylindrical body with two axial leads
4-band colour code red-red-brown (+ tolerance band, commonly gold) encodes 220 Ω
parts.electrical_limits_note: Power rating is not stored, so it is not checked.

sources.title: IEC 60062 resistor colour code (red = 2, brown = multiplier x10)

parts.verification_note: Only the nominal value implied by the colour code is stored. Wirewise checks that the user-confirmed value equals this nominal value; it does not measure resistance.

known_visual_features: Domed 5 mm epoxy lens with two leads
Anode lead is usually the longer lead
Cathode side usually has a flat spot on the lens rim and the larger internal anvil

orientation_metadata.note: Lead length is unreliable once leads are trimmed. Polarity must be confirmed by the user.

parts.electrical_limits_note: Forward voltage and current ratings vary by manufacturer and are not stored. LED current is NOT CHECKED.
parts.verification_note: Only terminal names and polarity cues are stored. No electrical rating is assumed.

known_visual_features: Insulated flexible wire with a pin at each end; any colour
parts.electrical_limits_note: Modelled as an ideal conductor. Broken or poorly seated wires cannot be detected from a photo.

breadboards.display_name: Half-size solderless breadboard, 400 tie points (30 rows, a-j)

connectivity_rules.description: In each numbered row, holes a, b, c, d and e are connected to each other.
In each numbered row, holes f, g, h, i and j are connected to each other.
The centre channel separates e from f. The two halves of a row are NOT connected.

unsupported_regions.description: The +/- power rails are not modelled in this MVP because rail segmentation differs between manufacturers. Connections to rails are reported as NOT CHECKED.

sources.title: Adafruit Half Sized Premium Breadboard - 400 Tie Points (product 64)

breadboards.verification_note: Terminal-strip geometry follows the standard 0.1 inch (2.54 mm) grid with a 0.3 inch centre channel (e to f). Check that your board's rows are numbered 1-30 and columns lettered a-j before using this model.
